fields.name: header_word_lo
fields.description: Low word of the 4-byte save header (logical bytes 06 8B, value 0x8B06). Probably a sequence/tag word paired with format_marker; exposed as a plain word because no checksum or fixed-magic comparison for it survives in the recovered decomp slice.
fields.evidence: Logical (rev8-unswapped) save offsets 0x00..0x04 hold 06 8B 34 12 per python rev8 analysis of samples/baseline.sav. Engine analogue: FUN_08004600 returns a 16-bit global mode word (*DAT_08004608) that FUN_0800a234 gates boot flow on (line 2867: if (iVar3 != 0x12)). EEPROM bus driver itself is outside the recovered 268-function decomp slice (no 0x0D000000/DAT_0d references).

fields.name: format_marker
fields.description: Save format marker with the classic value 0x1234 (logical bytes 34 12) at header offset +2. Read-only in practice; kept as a mutable-typed scalar (not a magic_signature) because only one baseline sample pins it.
fields.evidence: Logical save offset 0x02 reads LE u16 0x1234 in samples/baseline.sav after rev8 unswap (raw bytes at 0x04..0x06 are 12 34, i.e. the marker only aligns at offset +2 in the unswapped domain, supporting eeprom_rev8=true). Engine analogue: FUN_0803179c compares a 32-bit state/mode word against a ROM constant before acting (line 7358: *(int *)(param_1 + 0x34) == DAT_0803180c).

fields.name: status_flags
fields.description: Flag byte at the head of the 88-byte data block (value 0x80, bit 7 set, rest zero). Plausibly a status/valid bitmask for the block that follows; exact bit meanings are unknown from one sample.
fields.evidence: Logical save offset 0x163 holds 0x80 (first byte of the 0x163..0x1BB active run) in samples/baseline.sav. Engine analogue: FUN_0803177c sets/clears flag bits (0x0C vs 0x03) at state-struct offset +0 and clears bytes at +0x16/+0x1A predicated on the byte at +0x18 (lines 7335-7343).

fields.name: counter_a
fields.description: Small LE counter inside the data block (value 2, bytes 02 00). Could be a count, index, or stage selector; width is inferred from the zero high byte.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x181..0x183 read 02 00 (LE u16 = 2) in the rev8-unswapped image of samples/baseline.sav. Engine analogue: FUN_0800a234 keeps a u16 counter at *DAT_0800a318 + 0x220 that it increments by 1 and clamps to 0xFF (lines 2889-2896).

fields.name: counter_b
fields.description: Small LE counter inside the data block (value 8, bytes 08 00). Could be a count, size, or option level; width is inferred from the zero high byte.
fields.evidence: Logical save offsets 0x19E..0x1A0 read 08 00 (LE u16 = 8) in the rev8-unswapped image of samples/baseline.sav. Engine analogue: FUN_0803179c walks a counted-down loop (uVar2 = *(byte *)(param_1 + 8), decrement-and-test at lines 7360-7372) over state records.

fields.name: status_byte
fields.description: Standalone status/config byte near the end of the image (value 0x95). No 0x95 constant or checksum relation was found, so it is exposed as an opaque mutable byte rather than a checksum or enum.
fields.evidence: Logical save offset 0x1E3 holds 0x95 in samples/baseline.sav (sole non-FF byte of the 0x1C0..0x200 tail). Engine analogue: FUN_0803110c writes small status codes (0x80, 0x08, 0x00) into state bytes selected by a mode parameter (lines 6963-6984); no 0x95 literal occurs anywhere in the decomp, so no enum is asserted.
